title: ジャパンCの後に・Die Herzenslust

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash was able to stand her ground against her elite, senior-year opponents. It was a heated competition, but she's made undeniable progress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She'll likely have to race against the two of them again at the Arima Kinen, but Eishin Flash simply gives a confident nod and says that just means she'll have to win next time.
